question: What outcome regarding age and death follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: There is abstention from eating by day.
Age and death are mentioned together.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death associated with age.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ (overcome or undergo) is interpretively ambiguous.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death due to age.
